meta.description: Candlelit mysticism — antique fortune-teller machine meets tarot-card art, for a cat spirituality app.

patterns.glowPulse: box-shadow oscillates between shadow.glowGoldSm and shadow.glowGoldMd, 2400ms loop, used sparingly on active/focal mystical elements only
patterns.questionShift: duration.questionShift (380ms), easing.dreamy -- Phase 24: the quiz's confirm-and-advance transition for every question except the last -- the current question slides out (opacity + 18px translateX) while the next slides in from the opposite side, no full-screen overlay; the hint line beneath the options briefly shows a themed flavor line during the outgoing half. Replaced Phase 18's mid-quiz divination pattern below. See QuizFlow.tsx and globals.css's .quiz-question/.quiz-question--leaving/.quiz-question--enter
patterns.markConfirmSpin: duration.questionShift (380ms), easing.dreamy -- Phase 24: the confirmed quiz option's diamond mark plays one rotate+glow spin at the moment of confirmation, a small nod to a tarot card 'turning' without a full card-flip. See QuizFlow.tsx and globals.css's .mark-confirm-spin
patterns.spiritualReception: duration.divinationFinal (5000ms), easing.dreamy -- the last quiz question's held, full-screen themed pause before the real diagnosis is shown, gating navigation until both the animation and the request resolve (Phase 18, workplan.md; unchanged by Phase 24). See QuizFlow.tsx and globals.css's .divining-overlay/.divining-overlay--final
